'''Chokk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bloxian]] and the brother of [[Bakk]]. Chokk and his brother worked as [[Linkaas]]' goons. Since they were not considered to be smart, they were given jobs that required great strength and little thinking.
